title: How many Earths fit between Earth and the Moon?
subtitle: Guess how many Earths would fill the gap to the Moon, then watch all the other planets squeeze into the same gap, drawn to scale.
notes: Number-line guess, then 30 Earth discs drawn in the gap, then all seven planets to scale (giants as ellipses with polar diameter along the row, true flattening, so it is subtle); Moon nudged out to apogee.
